$comment: The DAK's indicators and performance metrics (component 6 of a WHO SMART Guidelines DAK). Definitions only: each says what is counted and how it is broken down, and states no target and no value. tools/ig-gen/ig_gen.py writes one FHIR Measure per indicator (input/fsh/dak/) and the Indicators page (input/pagecontent/indicators.md) from this file. `basis` is the FHIR resource an indicator counts, where this guide realises every record it counts: TD.IND.01 has none, since a DVC that fails verification is not yet a resource here (the verification Provenance exists only for a DVC that verified). Data elements are those of the upstream models the dictionary names, as <model id>.<path> (issue #33). tools/repo-checks/repo_checks.py checks that every data element, decision table and requirement it names exists.

indicators.title: Foreign doses imported as verified
indicators.definition: Of the foreign DVCs a clinic scans to verify, the proportion whose dose is recorded as verified.

numerator.description: Foreign DVCs scanned for verification in the reporting period whose dose was recorded as verified.
numerator.computation: COUNT of foreign DVCs the clinic's HCERT library verifies in the reporting period (CWT.header.4 found on the trust list) WHERE the dose is imported as an Immunization (IMMZImmunization) with primarySource = true

denominator.description: Foreign DVCs scanned for verification in the reporting period.
denominator.computation: COUNT of foreign DVCs the clinic's HCERT library is asked to verify in the reporting period, verified or not

disaggregations.label: Failure reason
disaggregations.description: the STT-VER-008 reason, for DVCs that did not verify

disaggregations.label: Issuing country
disaggregations.description: the participant that signed the DVC

indicators.title: Shared-link openings that were authorised
indicators.definition: Of the requests to open a family member's shared link, the proportion the home country released.

numerator.description: Manifest requests in the reporting period that were released.
numerator.computation: COUNT of manifest-request AuditEvent (TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess) WHERE AuditEvent.recorded is in the reporting period AND AuditEvent.outcome is success

denominator.description: Manifest requests in the reporting period, released or refused.
denominator.computation: COUNT of manifest-request AuditEvent (TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess) WHERE AuditEvent.recorded is in the reporting period

disaggregations.label: Requesting system
disaggregations.description: the receiver abroad, and its country

indicators.title: CHW referrals for verification completed at the clinic
indicators.definition: Of the referrals community health workers make for a child's foreign cards to be verified, the proportion completed at the clinic.

numerator.description: Referrals made in the reporting period for which the clinic has recorded an outcome for every dose the referral lists.
numerator.computation: COUNT of referral ServiceRequest (TrustDemoOnesaReferral) WHERE ServiceRequest.authoredOn is in the reporting period AND ServiceRequest.status = completed

denominator.description: Referrals for verification made by community health workers in the reporting period.
denominator.computation: COUNT of referral ServiceRequest (TrustDemoOnesaReferral) WHERE ServiceRequest.authoredOn is in the reporting period

indicators.title: Imported doses carrying a national schedule code
indicators.definition: Of the foreign doses imported as verified, the proportion that carry a national schedule code beside the issuer's code, and so count toward the schedule.

numerator.description: Doses imported as verified in the reporting period that carry a national schedule code.
numerator.computation: COUNT of Immunization (IMMZImmunization) WHERE primarySource = true AND imported in the reporting period AND vaccineCode has a coding from TrustDemoOnesaEpiScheduleCodes

denominator.description: Doses imported as verified in the reporting period.
denominator.computation: COUNT of Immunization (IMMZImmunization) WHERE primarySource = true AND imported in the reporting period
